newsitem.title: USA: Iron Mountain shares off after N.J. fire.
newsitem.headline: Iron Mountain shares off after N.J. fire.

text.p: Shares of Iron Mountain Inc fell one to 24-1/4 late morning Thursday after news of a fire at its facility in South Brunswick, New Jersey.

The company said the fire is not yet out and that despite early response by employees and fire department personnel, damage to the building which housed paper records was extensive. The fire is of suspicious origin and is under investigation by fire officials, Iron Mountain said. The company carries insurance to protect its assets and its operations, and is currently assessing the potential impact of the fire.

Iron Mountain operates 117 facilities nationally, providing business records storage and management services, data protection services for electronic records, vital records protection, and records management consulting services. The Company stores and manages document and electronic records for more than 23,000 customers, including more than half of the Fortune 500 companies.
